title.zh: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
title.en: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs

current_state.zh: Meta announced Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model it claims is the most capable US open-weight model to date and the first in its class to run on desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with Apple's MLX framework.
current_state.en: Meta announced Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model it claims is the most capable US open-weight model to date and the first in its class to run on desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with Apple's MLX framework.
